author: Jill Scott
title: December 13, 2025: Winter Work with the Tarot (Easthampton Location)
text:
Please join us on December 13th 2025 from 12:45 to 3PM for our December meeting at the Easthampton Library Annex at 52 Main Street Easthampton.
Winter is a metaphor for a time of introspection, rest, and release, symbolizing death and dormancy to make way for rebirth and new beginnings. It represents a period of slowing down, letting go of what no longer serves you, and preparing for the future while engaging in shadow work and learning lessons in resilience. This month we will we will apply this metaphor to tarot and try out some reading activities. You should leave this session with some food for thought to sustain you through our long New England Winter, or maybe even some ideas for creative projects, journaling exercises or rituals. If you have a deck that addresses seasons or something “wintery” it might be fun to bring that out. Any tarot deck will be fine, though. (Hosted by Jill) Hope to see you there!
*Reminder: Please arrive at 12:45 so we may start promptly at 1PM. Thanks!
